title: Sofic measures
abstract: Sofic measures, also known as hidden Markov measures, have been extensively studied. In this paper, we survey some equivalent definitions of this notion and improve a bound for deciding whether a sofic measure is~$k$-step Markov. We prove that if an invariant sofic measure with a linear representation of dimension~$n$ is a~$k$-step Markov chain, then~$k$ can be chosen at most equal to~$\binom{n}{2}$ and that this bound is tight for sofic measures over an alphabet of size $3$.
